title: 第153章 再次断层
slug: 电竞世界冠军选秀c位出道
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

几人再度散开，回归开场时一字横排的站位，前后队形镜像呼应。

他们紧绷的肩膀缓缓放松，整场舞台从压抑、对抗、突围中，最终归于沉静。

江执屿独自唱出收尾段落，声音清冷却穿透力十足：

“以渺小身躯扛所有砥砺

星火终燃整片天地”

最后一个字音消散的瞬间，六人原地定格，松弛地站着，双目平视前方。

灯光延迟两秒，才整片熄灭。

几乎是瞬间，潮水般的掌声轰然席卷场馆，尖叫声和呐喊声响彻全场，震得墙壁和地砖都微微发颤。

舞台灯光重新亮起，几人站在舞台上，被山呼海啸声淹没。

江执屿下意识低头瞥了眼胸口，确认蓝花没有在大幅度走位中脱落，才抬眸看向观众席。

【鸡皮疙瘩起来了，好燃啊，听得我头皮发麻！】

【我现在脑子嗡嗡的，最完美的妆造遇见最完美的舞台演绎，这组真神了。】

【江执屿身体力行的告诉所有人，他没有极限，下一次只会比上一次更完美……】

【震撼，R神神了……】

【从来没有想到过我有一天会捧着手机看爱豆舞台看到震惊，以前只会看着River操作震惊来着，我真理解我R哥为什么来选秀也能成为TOP了。】

【江执屿，聚光灯下的神！！！！】

贵宾区里的VaX已经呆滞了整首曲子的时间，大张着嘴看着舞台上表演完的江执屿移动，眼神中的震撼久久不消。

“你偶像厉害吧？”林石懒洋洋的声音从身侧传来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Several people dispersed again and returned to the straight-line position at the beginning, with the front and rear formations mirroring each other.

Their tense shoulders slowly relaxed, and the entire stage went from depression, confrontation, breakout, and finally fell into silence.

Jiang Zhiyu sang the closing paragraph alone, his voice was cool and penetrating:

"Carry all the hard work with a small body

The spark will finally light up the whole world.”

The moment the last word disappeared, the six people froze in place, standing relaxedly, looking straight ahead.

The light is delayed for two seconds before the entire film is extinguished.

Almost instantly, a wave of applause swept through the venue, and screams and shouts resounded throughout the venue, making the walls and floor tiles tremble slightly.

The stage lights came back on, and several people stood on the stage, drowned by the roar of the mountains and the tsunami.

Jiang Zhiyu subconsciously glanced down at his chest to make sure that the blue flower had not fallen off during the large movement, and then raised his eyes to look at the audience.

[Goosebumps are rising, it’s so burning, my scalp is numb when I hear it!】

[My mind is buzzing right now. The most perfect makeup meets the most perfect stage performance. This group is really amazing.】

[Jiang Zhiyu tells everyone personally that he has no limits, and the next time will only be more perfect than the last time...]

[Shocking, R is amazing...]

[I never thought that one day I would hold my phone and watch the idol stage and be shocked. In the past, I would only be shocked watching River’s actions. I really understand why my R brother came to the draft and became the top.】

[Jiang Zhiyu, the god in the spotlight!!!!】

VaX in the VIP area had been stunned for the entire song. He watched Jiang Zhiyu move on the stage with his mouth wide open, the shock in his eyes lingering for a long time.

"Is your idol great?" Lin Shi's lazy voice came from his side.
